snapshot_date.meaning: Business date of the gold snapshot, usually based on Asia/Bangkok/Myanmar-side reporting date.

snapshot_timestamp.meaning: Exact timestamp when the gold API data was ingested.

market_name.meaning: Name of the reference market source, for example myanmar_market_manual.

gold_symbol.meaning: Gold market symbol from the API, for example FOREXCOM:XAUUSD.

gold_currency.meaning: Currency used by the gold API, usually USD.

xau_usd_price.meaning: Global gold price in USD from the Gold API.

xau_usd_bid.meaning: Bid price for XAU/USD from the Gold API.

xau_usd_ask.meaning: Ask price for XAU/USD from the Gold API.

xau_usd_change.meaning: Absolute price change from the Gold API.

xau_usd_change_percent.meaning: Percentage price change from the Gold API.

xau_usd_price_gram_16k.meaning: Gold API 16K gold price per gram in USD.

xau_usd_price_gram_24k.meaning: Gold API 24K gold price per gram in USD.

official_usd_mmk_rate.meaning: Official CBM USD/MMK rate, currently 2100 MMK per USD.

unofficial_usd_mmk_buy_rate.meaning: Manual unofficial Myanmar market USD/MMK buy rate.

unofficial_usd_mmk_sell_rate.meaning: Manual unofficial Myanmar market USD/MMK sell rate.

unofficial_usd_mmk_mid_rate.meaning: Midpoint of unofficial USD/MMK buy and sell rates.

official_gold_kyat_thar_16k_mmk.meaning: Official Myanmar 16K gold price for 1 kyat-thar in MMK.

unofficial_gold_kyat_thar_16k_buy_mmk.meaning: Manual unofficial Myanmar market buy price for 1 kyat-thar of 16K gold.

unofficial_gold_kyat_thar_16k_sell_mmk.meaning: Manual unofficial Myanmar market sell price for 1 kyat-thar of 16K gold.

unofficial_gold_kyat_thar_16k_mid_mmk.meaning: Midpoint of unofficial 16K gold buy and sell prices.

gold_unit_name.meaning: Local gold unit name, for example kyat_thar.

gold_unit_grams.meaning: Gram conversion for 1 kyat-thar. Currently 16.3293 grams.

gold_karat.meaning: Gold purity used for Myanmar reference price, for example 16K.

implied_gold_kyat_thar_16k_official_mmk.meaning: Estimated 1 kyat-thar 16K gold price in MMK using global 16K gram price and official USD/MMK.

implied_gold_kyat_thar_16k_unofficial_bu.meaning: Estimated 1 kyat-thar 16K gold price in MMK using global 16K gram price and unofficial USD/MMK buy rate.

implied_gold_kyat_thar_16k_unofficial_se.meaning: Estimated 1 kyat-thar 16K gold price in MMK using global 16K gram price and unofficial USD/MMK sell rate.

implied_gold_kyat_thar_16k_unofficial_mi.meaning: Estimated 1 kyat-thar 16K gold price in MMK using global 16K gram price and unofficial USD/MMK midpoint.

fx_market_premium_buy_pct.meaning: Percentage gap between unofficial USD/MMK buy rate and official USD/MMK rate.

fx_market_premium_sell_pct.meaning: Percentage gap between unofficial USD/MMK sell rate and official USD/MMK rate.

fx_market_premium_mid_pct.meaning: Percentage gap between unofficial USD/MMK midpoint and official USD/MMK rate.

gold_official_to_market_buy_premium_pct.meaning: Percentage gap between unofficial 16K gold buy price and official 16K gold price.

gold_official_to_market_sell_premium_pct.meaning: Percentage gap between unofficial 16K gold sell price and official 16K gold price.

gold_official_to_market_mid_premium_pct.meaning: Percentage gap between unofficial 16K gold midpoint price and official 16K gold price.

gold_market_buy_sell_abs_spread_mmk.meaning: Absolute MMK difference between unofficial gold buy and sell prices.

gold_market_buy_sell_abs_spread_pct.meaning: Buy-sell spread as a percentage of the unofficial gold midpoint price.

source_note.meaning: Human note describing where/how the manual reference values were collected.

processed_at.meaning: Timestamp when this Gold-layer row was generated.
